cohort: The study included newborns admitted to public hospitals in Northern Ethiopia in 2019.
finding: The prevalence of birth asphyxia was 20.0%, and factors such as induction of labor, prolonged labor, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, referred mothers, instrumental delivery, and primiparous mothers were significantly associated with it.
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of birth asphyxia.
